source: The signed facts file's usage notes (facts/insights360.v1.json) and the knowledge set's brand-voice article. Linted over text the research agent authored, never over quotes. An entry fires only in a sentence that names the product (Insights360, the product, the platform, our platform, we) unless it says productOnly: false; a match preceded in its sentence by a negation or a reporting word (never, not, avoid, exclude, claims, says, wrongly...) is guidance, not a claim, and is skipped unless the entry says negatable: false.

entries.sayInstead: internally audited
entries.why: the tenant-isolation audit was internal, not a third-party penetration test

entries.sayInstead: post-call; results the same day or within a couple of hours
entries.why: post-call only: no websockets or streaming; results lag up to about an hour

entries.pattern: \b(?:typically |usually )?within (?:a few |few )?minutes\b|\b(?:in|within) (?:seconds|minutes) of (?:the|a) call\b|\bminutes after the call\b
entries.sayInstead: same day, or within a couple of hours
entries.why: ingestion polls about every 15 minutes, then transcription, then an hourly sync

entries.pattern: \bnever leaves the uk\b|\bnever leaves uk\b|\buk data residency\b|\bdata (?:stays|remains|is kept) (?:in|within) the uk\b|\b(?:hosted|stored|processed|held) (?:in|within) the uk\b|\buk[- ]hosted\b|\bhosted in britain\b
entries.sayInstead: EU (Frankfurt)
entries.why: processing and storage are in the EU (Frankfurt), not the UK

entries.pattern: \b100 ?% of (?:your |their |all )?calls\b|\bevery call (?:you|they|your team|the firm) (?:make|makes|take|takes|handle|handles)\b|\bevery single call\b|\bevery call, (?:without|no) exception\b|\bnever misses a call\b
entries.sayInstead: every call we ingest
entries.why: the pipeline can lose calls on failure paths; literal 100% completeness is not promised

entries.sayInstead: works with recordings from that platform, scoped per customer during onboarding
entries.why: only 3CX, OAK (ClarifyGo) and RingCentral have automated feeds; the rest are scoped per customer

entries.sayInstead: name what actually connects, and how
entries.why: brand voice bans 'seamless'; the facts note bans it for integrations

entries.pattern: \bfree trial\b|\bfree to start\b|\bstart (?:for )?free\b|\bget started in (?:seconds|minutes)\b|\bset ?up in (?:seconds|minutes)\b|\binstant(?:ly)? (?:set ?up|onboard\w*|live|available)\b|\bno set ?up fees?\b
entries.sayInstead: a GBP 1,280 setup and a GBP 640 configuration review around month one
entries.why: there is a one-off setup fee and a month-one configuration review

entries.sayInstead: Conversant is ISO 27001 certified
entries.why: the certificate is Conversant's, at group level; do not claim a product scope beyond it

entries.sayInstead: nothing: no customer is named
entries.why: Trifle Solutions is not a customer and must never be referenced

entries.sayInstead: in production with paying customers, unnamed and uncounted
entries.why: no customer may be named or counted, and no case-study numbers exist

entries.sayInstead: analyses the recordings your phone system already makes
entries.why: Insights360 does not record calls and is not a MiFID or voice-retention product

entries.sayInstead: Bedrock (Claude Haiku) analysis
entries.why: sentiment comes from the Bedrock analysis call; there is no Comprehend in the code

entries.sayInstead: dashboard KPIs with period comparison
entries.why: automatic anomaly callouts are not built

entries.sayInstead: one scorecard per firm
entries.why: one scorecard per tenant; team entities do not ship in the UI

entries.sayInstead: customer-side and per-call sentiment
entries.why: agent-side sentiment is computed but not shown to users

entries.sayInstead: configurable risk types that flag vulnerability-related calls
entries.why: risk flagging is configurable risk types, not a purpose-built vulnerability module

entries.sayInstead: read-only coaching points on each call
entries.why: coaching points are read-only; there is no in-app editing or authoring

entries.sayInstead: a needs-review list
entries.why: it is a list, not a workflow: no assignment, status or SLA tracking

entries.pattern: \bfull audit trail\b|\baudit trail of every (?:user |single )?action\b|\bcomplete audit (?:trail|log) of (?:every|all) (?:user )?actions?\b
entries.sayInstead: an append-only audit log of settings changes
entries.why: coverage today is settings writes; team and role changes are being added

entries.sayInstead: a single-call transcript PDF export
entries.why: export is one call at a time, browser-side; no bulk or scheduled export

entries.sayInstead: no accuracy figure: none is written down
entries.why: no transcription accuracy figure exists in the sources

entries.pattern: \blisten to the evidence\b|\bin[- ]app (?:audio )?playback\b|\b(?:play|replay) (?:back )?(?:the )?(?:call|recording|audio) in (?:the )?(?:app|dashboard)\b|\bsynchroni[sz]ed transcripts?\b|\bword[- ]level confidence\b
entries.sayInstead: the transcript, scores and summary for each call
entries.why: audio playback in the app is planned, not shipped

entries.sayInstead: supervisors and managers see agent performance
entries.why: there is no agent self-service portal; do not target agents

entries.sayInstead: a single-call PDF and the settings audit log
entries.why: compliance evidence packs are planned, not shipped

entries.sayInstead: one dashboard per firm
entries.why: there is no group or cross-tenant dashboard, and none is on the roadmap

entries.pattern: \b(?:insights ?360|the product|the platform|our platform|it)\b[^.;]{0,40}\b(?:offers?|supports?|provides?|has|includes?|comes with)\b[^.;]{0,20}\b(?:sso|single sign[- ]on|saml|scim|pii redaction|card[- ]number redaction|redaction|crm (?:connectors?|integrations?|sync))\b|\bredacts? (?:pii|card numbers|personal data)\b
entries.sayInstead: login via email and password (Clerk); no SSO, SCIM, redaction or CRM connector today
entries.why: SSO/SCIM, PII and card-number redaction and CRM connectors are planned, not shipped

entries.sayInstead: retention is agreed per contract and applied manually today
entries.why: there is no automated retention or deletion; never state a retention period

entries.sayInstead: name the coverage: post-call scoring of the recordings the phone system makes
entries.why: brand voice: Insights360 is not end-to-end (it does not record and is not real-time)
